items.event: Davis Cup Finals semi-final: Spain v Great Britain (Bologna)
items.line: Spain, expected to have Carlos Alcaraz, start as favourites against a British side whose doubles pair Patten and Skupski won the deciding rubber against Germany. The other semi-final, Italy v Czechia, was level 1-1 and going to the deciding doubles at the time of writing.

items.event: DP World Tour: BMW Australian PGA Championship, The Lakes, Sydney
items.line: Nicolai von Dellingshausen leads by three at -13 after a second-round 64 that included an albatross. Tom McKibbin is on -10 and Cam Smith -9 after a 64. Defending champion David Puig is T15 at -5. Round 3 is Saturday and the final round is Sunday.

items.line: ESPN calls this the biggest game of the season so far: an Arsenal win at the Emirates would open a nine-point gap over City. City arrive on a winless league run, with the fallout from the 114-charge financial case in the background.
